$comment: English texts of data/winter.json (src/engine/winter.js): the names of the camp's decorations and the words of the calendar's window and tab.

texts.title: Generous Feast
texts.lead: From 1 to 24 December, one reward a day for coming into the game, and on the 24th the winter set. A day missed is lost.
texts.taken: Taken. Come back tomorrow for the next window.
texts.done: The whole calendar is taken. Happy Generous Feast!
texts.decorationGot: {name} will stand in your Camp until the end of December.
texts.setGot: The winter set is yours: the Hoarfrost frame, the Generous Feast background and the Snowstorm aura wait in the System Shop, ready to wear.
texts.closed: The Generous Feast calendar opens from 1 to 24 December.
texts.alreadyTaken: Today's window is already open. Come back tomorrow.
texts.bagFull: The bag is full. Make room in it for the potions and take the reward.
texts.changed: The calendar changed in the meantime. Try again.
texts.tabWaiting: Generous Feast calendar: the reward of December {day} is waiting
texts.tabTaken: Generous Feast calendar: the reward of December {day} is taken
